Definition: verdant; by analogy, new; figuratively, prosperous
BiblicalUsage: They build high places under every green tree, says the history of the kings. But the psalmist says, I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever. The word is the verdant itself — green, new, flourishing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the green tree can hide idolatry and the green olive tree can hold a trusting soul, and the difference is where it grows.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
